summary: Phase E7 RETEST of the iteration_25 HIGH bug: Undo button in Sonner toast unclickable while a Radix modal (FlatDrawer / PostPayment sheet) is open. Login as admin@kkt.in → Tower A (/blocks/4e99bd2c-25eb-45b8-91a5-501b4a5295c2) → click A-801 → FlatDrawer opens → click 'Mark Hold' → bottom-right toast with Undo appears → REAL MOUSE CLICK via page.mouse.click() on Undo → handler runs, 'A-801 back to Blocked' confirmation toast fires, flat status reverts in DB. The pointer-events / z-index fix in src/index.css (last 3 lines) is working: [data-sonner-toaster] computed z-index=10000 and pointer-events=auto; [data-sonner-toast] pointer-events=auto; Toaster is in bottom-right (data-position attribute is null in current build but visual + bbox confirm bottom-right origin at (1540, 982) on a 1920×1080 viewport). CORE BUG FIX IS VERIFIED. One residual behavior noted: the FlatDrawer Sheet CLOSES immediately after the Undo click lands on the toast (likely Radix pointer-down-outside firing even with pointer-events:auto on the toast portal). The handler still completes, status still reverts, and the second toast still appears, so the user is NOT blocked — but the review stated 'drawer still open' which no longer holds.

ui_bugs.issue: After the fix the Undo button inside the toast IS clickable with page.mouse.click() (handler runs, status reverts, follow-up toast fires). HOWEVER the Sheet now auto-closes the moment the Undo click is processed. The review's acceptance criterion ('drawer still open') is NOT met. Suspected cause: Radix Dialog's pointerDownOutside handler fires because the Sonner viewport is a portal sibling of the Dialog overlay; pointer-events:auto on the toast lets the click register on the Undo button but the event ALSO reaches the overlay/outside listener, which closes the Sheet via onOpenChange(false). Mitigation: in FlatDrawer.jsx, add  onPointerDownOutside={(e) => { if (e.target?.closest?.('[data-sonner-toast]')) e.preventDefault(); }} (or onInteractOutside) to <SheetContent>, so clicks that originate inside a toast do not dismiss the dialog. Same guard will fix PostPayment sheet too.

action_items: Core bug (iteration_25 HIGH) is FIXED and VERIFIED — the toast Undo button is now reachable with a real mouse click while a Radix modal is open. No further CSS work needed.

SECONDARY MEDIUM issue: the FlatDrawer Sheet closes immediately after Undo clicks are received. Add onPointerDownOutside guard to SheetContent in FlatDrawer.jsx (and PostPayment sheet) that calls e.preventDefault() when e.target.closest('[data-sonner-toast]') truthy. Then the drawer will stay open per the original acceptance criterion.

Part B (PostPayment sheet toast X) could not produce a validation-error toast because the submit button is disabled until Mode/Amount are set (client-side gating). Suggest a separate test that posts an invalid-mode payment via the sheet to force a backend error toast, so the X-click layering can be exercised. CSS-level fix is already proven in Part A so this is low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/index.css lines 174-176: correct minimal fix. z-index:10000 is well above Radix Dialog overlay (z-50). pointer-events:auto on toaster AND inner toast + buttons ensures clicks reach the action button. Good.

frontend/src/App.js line 35: Toaster props updated to position='bottom-right' richColors closeButton with 6s duration — matches request. Note data-position attribute is not visible on the DOM element (Sonner may apply via inline style instead of attribute); the toast visually renders at bottom-right as expected (bbox 1540,982 on 1920×1080).

FlatDrawer.jsx line 58: <Sheet open={!!flatId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>. Radix Sheet is modal by default; without onPointerDownOutside guard, any pointer-down that is NOT inside SheetContent — including inside the Sonner portal — fires onOpenChange(false) and closes the drawer. This is why real-mouse Undo clicks close the drawer today, even though the toast action handler still runs.

rca of the issue: iteration_25 bug (Undo click intercepted by Radix overlay) is RESOLVED by the two CSS rules in frontend/src/index.css. The remaining 'drawer closes after undo' is a different, lower-severity bug: Radix Dialog in modal mode treats a pointer-down anywhere outside the dialog subtree as an outside interaction, including into the Sonner portal (which is a sibling of the Radix overlay). Even though pointer-events:auto on the toast lets the click register on the Undo <button>, the same event also triggers Radix's internal outside-click detection and calls onOpenChange(false). Fix at the drawer level, not the toast: add onPointerDownOutside={(e) => { if (e.target?.closest?.('[data-sonner-toast]')) e.preventDefault(); }} on <SheetContent> in FlatDrawer.jsx and the PostPayment sheet. This keeps the toast interaction model (click Undo, keep working in context) consistent with the review's acceptance criteria.
